faqs.question: What should I wear?
faqs.answer: Basically, whatever you like! Just don’t complain if you get cold: our wedding will be in the evening, and we’re hoping for good weather so we can spend as much time as possible outside in the garden.

faqs.question: How do I get there?
faqs.answer: You’ll find all the directions to the villa below. If you have any questions or need a hand planning your journey, just write to us!

faqs.question: Can I bring my dog?
faqs.answer: Sorry, Akamaru will be the only four-legged guest at the wedding. Please leave your furry friend at home.

faqs.question: What can I give you?
faqs.answer: Actually, we’d like to turn the question around: what can we give you for all the effort you’ll make to be here with us? Don’t expect a wedding gift list, bank details or a box for cash gifts. We know that for some of you, being here will mean planning a trip, taking time off work and making a few sacrifices. The best gift you can give us is sharing this day with us. Don’t miss it!

faqs.question: Where can I park?
faqs.answer: Villa Valentina has supervised parking on site, so leave your car at the villa and enjoy the day.

faqs.question: Where can I stay overnight?
faqs.answer: If you’re looking for somewhere to stay, we can recommend a hotel with a special arrangement with the villa, {hotel}. Write to us if you’re interested!
